MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

2. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

   A. 81

   C. 10
   D. 9

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 22
   C. 18
   D. 36

5. What is √100? (1 mark)

   B. 50
   C. 10
   D. 11

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)

   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

   C. 27
   D. 27.6

   A. 44

   C. 30

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 33
   C. 14
   D. 22

16. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 30

18. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

19. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

20. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

21. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

22. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 19
   C. 7
   D. 23

23. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 14

24. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

25. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16

   D. 8

26. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)

27. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)

28. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400

   C. 10
   D. 4

29. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 11
   C. 25
   D. 5

30. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170
